variants.headline: Food provision requires attention
variants.body: Food is insufficient in {colony}, and residents are going hungry. Adequate provision must be the immediate public priority. The position merits attention.

variants.headline: Hunger sets the practical standard
variants.body: Residents of {colony} are hungry because there is not enough food. The practical measure of a remedy is adequate provision. The position merits attention.

variants.headline: Insufficient food entered in public record
variants.body: The gazette records insufficient food and hunger in {colony}. Clear information is necessary; practical provision is the essential objective. The position merits attention.
